title: "journal_emitted_divergence"
description: "Replaying the journal emitted different domain events than were recorded."
---

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-docs.mts from the website's docs. Do not edit: run `pnpm docs:gen`. -->

**What happened:** Replaying the journal emitted different domain events than were recorded.

**How to fix it:** Keep emitted events stable, or upcast old ones in a `versions` step (`emitted: { Name: (old) => new }`).

Thrown as an `ActorKitError` (or a subclass) whose `code` is this one and whose `docs` is this page.

The error's `message` names the specifics (the message, state, binding or value involved). See all [error codes](/errors/).
